summary: In Ansible 10.7.0, ibm.spectrum_virtualize was renamed to ibm.storage_virtualize. Both are included for now, but the old name will be removed in Ansible 12, so FQCNs should be updated.
questions: Should I still use ibm.spectrum_virtualize module names?
What is the new name of the IBM Spectrum Virtualize collection?

answer_card.title: ibm.spectrum_virtualize renamed
answer_card.answer_md: `ibm.spectrum_virtualize` is now `ibm.storage_virtualize`. Both ship for now, but the old one is removed in Ansible 12. Update your FQCNs to `ibm.storage_virtualize.*`.
